evaluations.rationale: This requests visibility of who has submitted (not their estimates); it does not conflict with the requirement to reveal estimates simultaneously.

evaluations.evidence: be shown all estimates at the same time after all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: Requires that estimates are revealed only after all estimators have given, which is incompatible with moderator ability to show estimates immediately (PP-009).

evaluations.rationale: Allows changing until reveal; this rule is incompatible with a moderator action that can reveal estimates immediately (PP-009).
